t: Albion Chapel is gone now. It stood near Finsbury Circus, on the corner of London Wall and Finsbury Pavement, on the site of the old Bethlem Royal Hospital. It was a Scottish Presbyterian chapel, established by Reverend Alexander Fletcher in 1815, and it was demolished in 1879. It was designed by William Jay, who later became a leading architect in the United States. The material also names an English nonconformist clergyman of the same name, but that is a different man, so I'll leave him out.
